answer: Idena proved the danger is rented hands: 23 operators held 40% of accounts, paying humans $2-14 an epoch while holding keys. Each ballot is an ember on its own island, fed by a live pulse each tide, a two-second check no replay can fake. Puppet farms die by the one-hand check: two embers fed by one hand in one tide, both go dark, stakes burned. Forging 10,000 ballots needs 10,000 live hands on call each tide, 5.6 hours of pulses, $25 staked apiece, $250,000 frozen. Like a willow it bends with each tide, yet an ember with no keeper goes cold, and each cold ember is $25 burned for nothing.
